name: commit-tools
description: Generate a commit message from staged Git changes with Codex.

codexCommit.commandPath.description: Optional path to the Codex CLI executable. Leave empty to use the Codex bundled with ChatGPT.app, then PATH.

codexCommit.language.description: Language for the generated commit subject.

codexCommit.conventional.description: Ask Codex to use the Conventional Commits format.

codexCommit.model.description: Codex model to use. The default Astra model is fast for this short task.

codexCommit.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort passed to Codex. Low is recommended for short commit messages.

codexCommit.prompt.default: Describe the staged changes accurately and choose the most useful commit subject for a reviewer.
codexCommit.prompt.description: Additional instructions for the commit-message generator. The staged-only and one-line output rules are always enforced.
